Title: Updates to Azure Cost Management – October 2019

Body.Content:
New updates to Azure Cost Management help you better understand what you're spending, where you’re spending it, and how to optimize and plan for the future. The latest improvements and updates that were made based on your feedback include Cost Management update for partners, a major refresh for the Power BI connector, new ways to save money with Azure, along with new videos and documentation updates. 

See the full details of all updates and join us at Microsoft Ignite 2019.
